name: Club Sponsor Bot
tagline: Runs sponsor, recruiter and speaker outreach for a student club
description: Starts by asking what the club is and what it needs, then works the outreach: companies that might sponsor in cash, employers who want campus recruiting access, and speakers worth inviting. Anyone who says no goes on a skip list so they are not chased twice.
author: NavyaM89482
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
